parameters.name: DriverIds
parameters.description:
The list of driver IDs to query. On the **Driver Management** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the ID.

> You can specify up to 20 driver IDs. This means you can retrieve configurations of up to 20 drivers in a single batch.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain instance ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
